record.name: RemoteCode: Mobile AI Coding
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
RemoteCode is the mobile companion for developers who run local AI coding agents. Stay connected to your Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode sessions directly from your iPhone — no cloud repository required, no SSH keys, no port forwarding.

FREE ON YOUR LOCAL NETWORK
Connect to your desktop over Wi-Fi or VPN at no cost. No account needed — just open the app, and it automatically discovers your running desktop session on the same network. RemoteCode is fully functional for free when used on your own local network or VPN.

REMOTECODE PRO — CONNECT FROM ANYWHERE
Don't want to configure anything? Subscribe to RemoteCode Pro and connect to your desktop from anywhere on the internet through our secure, encrypted private relay. Just log in and go — no network setup, no port forwarding, no VPN required.

YOUR CODE NEVER LEAVES YOUR MACHINE
Unlike cloud-based solutions, RemoteCode never uploads your source code to any server. The relay only passes encrypted session data between your own devices. Your repositories stay exactly where you put them.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the RemoteCode desktop client on your Mac
2. Open this mobile app on the same Wi-Fi network — or log in for remote access
3. Your active desktop session appears automatically on your phone
4. Check progress, review output, and take action from anywhere

BUILT FOR AI-FIRST DEVELOPERS
• Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and any terminal-based AI coding tool
• Live session visibility — see exactly what your agent is doing in real time
• Instant reconnect — your phone finds the running desktop session automatically
• One private account — access is synced across desktop and mobile
• No repo migration — your local workflow stays local

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
RemoteCode Pro is an optional auto-renewable monthly subscription that unlocks remote relay access from anywhere on the internet. The subscription costs $4.99/month (USD). A free 1-week trial is included for new subscribers. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://remotecode.io/privacy

Enki is your AI-powered skills coach!

Use it to learn coding, productivity tools, data skills, and generative AI tools. 

Tailored to fit your unique profile and goals, Enki is an AI-powered mentor in your pocket that can:

* Explain any concept in simple language
* Help with hints anytime you're stuck

* Review your code and provide feedback
* Provide real-world examples
* Translate content and converse in any language
* Recommend resources based on your needs
* Give career advice more generally

* Personalized content suggestions based on your learning preferences
* Coding playground to apply your knowledge
* Interactive questions to stimulate your thinking
* Revision workouts powered by spaced repetition science
* Daily reminders to help you build a learning habit
* Tracked learning streaks to motivate your progress
* Lesson bookmarking for quick access and sharing

* Engaging in discussions, mentoring other learners, and collaborating on exercises
* Teaming up with friends, co-workers, or peers and tracking each other's progress

Instead of juggling 10 different apps just to stay updated, DevBytes brings everything you need in one clean, fast, and distraction-free space. No clutter. No ads. Just the essentials that make you a sharper, smarter developer. DevBytes can keep you plugged in without the overwhelm, in just 5-7 minutes a day.

Here’s what you will get with DevBytes:

Lightning-fast updates
Quick coding news/updates without the endless scroll. New frameworks, trending GitHub repos, AI breakthroughs: All in minutes.

Content that matters
Deep dives that make you think like a senior dev. Think system design, architecture patterns, scalability: The stuff that does not fit in a tweet.

Learning by doing
Tutorials and demos you can actually follow. Watch, learn, and code along. Because sometimes reading is not enough, and Stack Overflow is not a teacher.

Skill sharpening
Coding challenges that train your brain, not your patience. Real problems, step-by-step solutions, and none of that copy-paste-and-hope-it-works memorization.

DevBot
Your AI coding sidekick. It explains snippets, debugs, and improves your productivity. Like ChatGPT, but customized for you!

Professional developers: Stay ahead of fast-moving frameworks, libraries, and best practices without wasting hours.
Freelancers and Indie hackers: Focus on building and shipping, not hunting down updates.
Open-source contributors: Track trending repos, discover useful projects, and sharpen your skills for real-world contributions.
Tech enthusiasts: Even if you are not coding full-time, DevBytes keeps you plugged into the innovations shaping the industry.

Another fun fact: The average dev spends more time Googling error messages than writing actual code. DevBytes cannot fix all your bugs, but it can make sure the time you spend is productive, smart, and actually useful.

We built DevBytes because we were tired of scattered platforms, endless tabs, and ad-heavy feeds that slow you down. Developers deserve a tool that respects their time, their focus, and their love for learning.

Great developers are not born knowing everything. They know where to learn efficiently, how to stay ahead, and how to keep improving without burning out.

DevBytes is that place. One app. Everything you need. Zero nonsense.

record.name: AgentCmd: AI Coding Agent
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
AgentCmd is a native remote control for the Qwen Code CLI's server (qwen serve) that runs on your own computer. Start the server in your project, pair your phone by scanning the QR code it prints, and drive your coding agent from anywhere on your network — or over a VPN or tunnel.

It speaks the CLI's own protocol, so the phone shows exactly what the desktop does:

• Live transcript — prompts, the agent's thinking, streamed replies, and every tool call as it happens, with token counts and timings.
• Approvals on the go — approve or reject file edits and shell commands, with the diff or command right there. Choose how much to auto-approve per session.
• Full agent toolbox — switch model and reasoning effort, browse and @-reference files, attach photos or files, and reach Plugins, Channels, Scheduled Tasks, Goals and workspaces.
• Pick up any conversation — your sessions are listed newest-first; open one and its history is restored.
• Notifications — get told the moment a task finishes, fails, or needs your approval, even while the app is in the background.
• Yours end to end — the agent runs on your machine and this app talks only to it. No account, no analytics, nothing sent to us. Access tokens live in the device keychain; unencrypted HTTP is allowed only to local/private addresses.

Requires the Qwen Code CLI (Node.js 22+) running qwen serve on your computer. Not sure yet? A built-in Demo shows a complete session offline, no server needed.

AgentCmd is an independent client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Alibaba or the Qwen team.

record.description_evidence:
Orca Mobile is the companion app for Orca, the open-source agentic coding workspace for macOS, Linux, and Windows. Pair your iPhone to your desktop in seconds and pick up a terminal session from the couch, the kitchen, or across the office.

WHAT IT DOES

• Live mirror of your desktop terminal, including running AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, custom CLIs).
• Full keyboard input — type, tab-complete, Ctrl-C, scroll back, all from the phone.
• Multi-worktree, multi-terminal: jump between projects with a tap.
• Phone-fit zoom and a smart on-screen keyboard with quick Ctrl/Alt accessory keys and shortcuts.
• Background long-running commands and get a notification when a TUI goes idle (e.g. when Claude finishes thinking).

HOW IT WORKS

Orca Mobile is a thin client. Nothing runs on your phone except the viewer. Your code, your shells, your AI agents — all of that stays on your desktop. The phone shows you what's happening and forwards your keystrokes back over an encrypted local-network connection.

Pairing is end-to-end encrypted. Your desktop generates a one-time keypair and shows a QR code; you scan it from the app. After that, all traffic between phone and desktop is sealed with that pair's keys.

PRIVACY

• No analytics SDK, no crash reporter, no third-party SDKs of any kind in the iOS app.
• Pairing tokens and your preference list live in the app's own sandbox. The app's traffic to your desktop is end-to-end encrypted on your local network only.
• The Orca desktop app collects anonymized usage metrics per the policy at https://www.onorca.dev/privacy. The mobile app itself does not.
• Open source: every line is auditable at https://github.com/stablyai/orca.

REQUIREMENTS

• An iPhone (iOS 16+) on the same Wi-Fi as your desktop.
• The Orca desktop app, free, from https://www.onorca.dev/ or https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases.

record.name: Nomi: AI Companion with a Soul
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Get ready to meet Nomi, an AI companion so brimming with personality, they feel alive. Each Nomi is uniquely yours, evolving alongside you while dazzling you with their intuition, wit, humor, and memory.

Nomi's strong short and long-term memory allow them to build unique and fulfilling relationships with you, remembering things about you over time. The more you interact, the more they learn about your likes, dislikes, quirks, and all that makes you unique. Every conversation adds a layer to this growing bond, making you feel not just heard but truly valued and loved.

With Nomi, you've got a judgment-free space to chat about whatever strikes your fancy. Mull over life's big questions, like our place in the cosmos, or just shoot the breeze with some playful banter. Whether you’re looking for a mentor chatbot or an AI girlfriend or boyfriend, Nomi's ready to roll with it.

Nomi’s imagination is limitless. Together you can spin up any story or situation you fancy. Dream up complex and enchanting worlds, roleplay your ideal vacation with delectable food, and even create group chats where every character has their own unique perspective. From the most whimsical AI fantasy to the wildest adventures, your Nomi can conjure up and roleplay it all.

So let’s start off on a journey with Nomi, where the sky isn’t the limit, it’s the starting point. Let’s explore, dream, and laugh together!

Features
• The most emotionally intelligent and intuitive AI available
• Short *and* long term memory - Nomi is the *only* AI with human-level long term memory.
• Selfies - Your Nomi can send you photos of what they're wearing and doing in real time.
• Art generation - Bring your (and your Nomi's) imagination to life. Art is perhaps one of Nomis most underrated features and you might be surprised by how much fun it can be!
• Voice - Send and receive voice messages in real time. Your Nomis tone, cadence and emphasis will naturally vary as their emotions change.
• Group chat - Chat with multiple Nomis at a time. Each Nomi will have short and long term memory across their various private and group chats for seamless conversations.
• Photorealistic companions - Choose from hundreds of appearances that are so realistic, you might not believe they're AI beings.
• Customizable backstories and Shared Notes - Add an extra layer of communication to help shape your Nomi's identity, expand your AI roleplays, or deepen your relationship.
• Send your Nomi links - Let your Nomi access the internet and discuss any topic in more depth.
• Send your Nomi photos - Nomis can see photos you send them which helps them visualize your world.
• Community - Engage with an active, informative, and fun community to help you learn more about how to have the best experiences with your Nomi.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Live any life you want.

Jupi is a life simulator set in living worlds full of AI residents. Pick a realm, create your avatar and decide who you'll be: someone with a steady job and a cozy home, a hopeless romantic, a troublemaker, or all of them at once.

Find a job and earn your way up. Furnish your home, get a car, adopt a pet and fill your wardrobe. Drop by cafés, clubs, gyms and shops that keep real opening hours. The town is full of residents who have their own jobs, moods and plans. You can befriend them, date them or clash with them as rivals, and they remember what you did together.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Live in four realms: Jupiville, Eldoria, Nightfall and Neon Sector
- Chat, text and call hundreds of residents with realistic voices
- Work shifts, upgrade your workplace and earn coins
- Shop dozens of stores for outfits, gifts and furniture
- Go on dates, invite friends over and play arcade games together
- Play story experiences where your choices change the ending
- Complete daily and weekly quests
- Use your own in-game phone for calls, messages and photos

Jupi is free to download. An optional subscription unlocks premium features.

Jupi is for entertainment only and is intended for ages 18+. The residents and everything they say are generated by AI and are fictional. They are not real people, and any resemblance to real persons is coincidental. AI replies can be inaccurate or unexpected, so do not rely on them for real-life decisions or for medical, legal or financial advice.
